description: This file defines the ProductImageService interface, which declares methods for managing product images, including adding, retrieving, removing, and updating images within the sales manager application.

classes.name: ProductImageService
classes.description: Interface for managing product images, including CRUD operations and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the database and CMS for a specified product.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image content with specified size from CMS.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Fetches all images associated with a particular product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing product image.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image file based on store code, product code, filename, and size.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple images to a product.
